results.text:
git init     creates one hidden folder,       .git   . That folder is the repository: all history,
branches and settings live inside it. Delete         .git   and the folder becomes an ordinary
folder again.

Look inside if you are curious (       ls .git    ), but let Git manage it. Also, never run
    git init      in your home folder or on your Desktop: only inside a project folder.

The three stages

This is the most important idea in Git. Every change passes through three places:

Staging area                           Repository
 Working directory                                                                       The  .git  folder
 Your folder — you            git add               The “index” —                            — saved
   edit files here                                 what goes in the     git commit          snapshots
                                                     next commit
